meta.project: ORBITAL-1 / Vision-Based On-Board Diagnostics for Hypervelocity Impact Characterization (IAC 2026)
meta.base_positive: RAW photo, high-resolution on-board inspection camera photograph of a satellite exterior surface in orbit, (photorealistic:1.2), extremely detailed metal surface texture, physically accurate impact damage, hard vacuum environment, sharp focus, 8k
meta.global_negative: (cartoon:1.3), anime, illustration, painting, drawing, sketch, watercolor, (3d render:1.2), cgi, video game, concept art, stylized, low quality, worst quality, lowres, jpeg artifacts, watermark, (text:1.3), caption, logo, signature, blurry, out of focus, deformed geometry, fantasy spaceship, retro sci-fi, (people:1.2), person, astronaut, hands, face, (fire:1.4), (flames:1.4), (smoke:1.4), explosion, sparks, burning, glowing embers, rust, corrosion, water droplets, rain, dust cloud, fog, haze, terrain, trees, buildings, oversaturated, neon colors
meta.note: Vacuum physics: no fire, smoke, flames or rust in orbit; keep them high-weight in the negative prompt. Vary the seed on every image.

damage_classes.label: crater
damage_classes.positive_core: (hemispherical hypervelocity impact crater:1.3) on satellite panel, raised curled molten rim lips, smooth bowl-shaped cavity, bright exposed bare metal inside crater, faint radial ejecta spray marks around rim, no penetration, intact surrounding surface

severity.minor: single tiny impact crater, sub-millimeter pit, barely raised rim
severity.moderate: distinct 5 mm hemispherical crater, pronounced molten lip, small ejecta ring
severity.severe: large deep crater with wide melted rim, cracked coating ring around cavity, near-marginal penetration bulge

damage_classes.negative_extra: through hole, penetration, light shining through, torn petals, radial crack network, shattered glass, spall, cluster of pits

damage_classes.label: perforation
damage_classes.positive_core: (clean circular perforation hole:1.35) punched through satellite panel by hypervelocity impact, everted molten rim, dark void visible through the hole, resolidified metal droplets near edge, hole slightly larger than projectile diameter, ballistic penetration

severity.minor: 1 mm pinhole perforation, thin bright rim
severity.moderate: 5 mm round through-hole, everted molten lip, faint ejecta stain
severity.severe: 20 mm ragged through-hole, deformed bulged panel around opening, torn coating

damage_classes.negative_extra: shallow crater, closed cavity, intact back surface, bent petals, spider-web cracks, torn fabric, multiple pits

damage_classes.label: petaling
damage_classes.positive_core: hypervelocity perforation with (petaling deformation:1.35), four to six jagged triangular metal petals bent outward around a central hole, torn thin aluminum sheet, bright fractured petal edges, hole visible between petals

severity.minor: small hole with slightly lifted petal edges
severity.moderate: clear petaled rupture, curled triangular flaps
severity.severe: large petaled breach with twisted torn flaps, surrounding sheet buckling

damage_classes.negative_extra: smooth round hole, clean rim, hemispherical crater, shattered glass, honeycomb core, melt droplets only

damage_classes.label: spallation
damage_classes.positive_core: (rear-face spallation damage:1.35) on satellite structural wall, circular patch of detached material, rough granular fracture surface, raised fractured ring edge, no through hole, shock-induced spall zone wider than the front crater

severity.moderate: clear detached spall disc, rough crater-free fracture patch
severity.severe: large deep spall zone, hanging partially attached fragment, bulged wall

damage_classes.negative_extra: through hole, light through hole, front-face molten crater rim, petals, glass cracks, foil tear

damage_classes.label: crack_web
damage_classes.positive_core: hypervelocity impact on brittle glass surface of satellite, (central pit with radial cracks:1.3) and concentric ring cracks, spider-web conchoidal fracture pattern, fine crack network catching the light, fractured but retained pane

severity.minor: tiny pit with three short hairline radial cracks
severity.moderate: pronounced star-shaped crack pattern with two ring cracks
severity.severe: dense shattered crack web, crushed central zone, missing small glass chips

damage_classes.negative_extra: metal crater, molten rim, through hole, petals, torn foil, honeycomb, melted droplets

damage_classes.label: mli_damage
damage_classes.positive_core: (torn multi-layer insulation blanket:1.3) on satellite, gold kapton foil with hypervelocity puncture, curled melted foil edges, exposed inner silver mylar layers, wrinkled crinkled thermal blanket around damage, dark hole through the layered foil stack

severity.minor: small puncture in outer kapton layer only, pinhole with curled edge
severity.moderate: torn opening through several foil layers, silver layers visible
severity.severe: large ripped MLI flap hanging stiffly, full stack breach, exposed structure beneath

damage_classes.negative_extra: rigid metal crater, molten aluminum rim, glass cracks, solar cells, smooth painted panel, honeycomb core

damage_classes.label: solar_damage
damage_classes.positive_core: hypervelocity impact damage on satellite solar array, (shattered solar cell cover glass:1.3), radial and concentric cracks spreading across dark blue photovoltaic cells, missing glass shards exposing dark silicon, broken silver gridlines, central penetration pit, adjacent intact cells with regular grid pattern

severity.minor: single cracked cover glass on one cell, hairline fracture star
severity.moderate: two or three shattered cells, chipped glass, cracked neighbors
severity.severe: wide shattered damage zone across the array, hole through the panel substrate, dangling cell fragments

damage_classes.negative_extra: metal crater only, torn gold foil, petals, honeycomb core, white radiator tiles

damage_classes.label: debris_spray
damage_classes.positive_core: (debris cloud impact spray pattern:1.35) on satellite rear wall behind Whipple shield, hundreds of small clustered craters and pits, dense central damage cluster with annular halo ring of fine pits, shotgun-like spray of micro craters, bulged but unperforated wall

severity.minor: sparse spray of shallow pits, faint central cluster
severity.moderate: distinct central cluster and halo ring of small craters
severity.severe: dense overlapping crater cluster, several small perforations at center, deformed wall

damage_classes.negative_extra: single large crater, one clean round hole, glass crack web, torn blanket, petals

damage_classes.label: cfrp_delamination
damage_classes.positive_core: hypervelocity impact on (carbon fiber composite satellite panel:1.2), (delamination with fiber breakout:1.3), frayed broken carbon fibers around a ragged hole, separated composite plies lifting at the edges, dull black woven twill texture, crushed resin fragments

severity.minor: small surface delamination blister, few lifted fibers
severity.moderate: ragged hole with frayed fiber ring, visible ply separation
severity.severe: wide delaminated zone, splayed broken fiber bundles, rear-face breakout larger than entry

damage_classes.negative_extra: shiny aluminum, molten metal rim, glass cracks, gold foil, white paint, honeycomb cells

damage_classes.label: microcrater_field
damage_classes.positive_core: satellite surface with (field of scattered micrometeoroid impact pits:1.3), dozens of sub-millimeter microcraters randomly distributed, sandblasted eroded thermal coating, tiny bright pits in the paint, long-duration space exposure weathering

severity.minor: a few faint scattered micro pits
severity.moderate: dozens of visible micro craters, dulled eroded coating
severity.severe: dense pitting across the whole surface, chipped coating patches, one or two larger pits

damage_classes.negative_extra: single large crater, through hole, crack network, torn blanket, clustered central spray pattern

damage_classes.label: melt_splash
damage_classes.positive_core: impact melt splash residue on satellite panel, (dark radial star-shaped ejecta deposit:1.3) around a small central pit, resolidified metal droplets sprayed outward, thin-film discoloration ring, vacuum-deposited stain pattern

severity.minor: faint discoloration halo around a tiny pit
severity.moderate: clear star-shaped dark deposit with radial rays
severity.severe: wide splattered melt deposit, thick droplet trails, discolored zone spanning the panel

damage_classes.negative_extra: flames, burning, soot cloud, glowing hot metal, large hole, crack web, torn foil

damage_classes.label: structural_severe
damage_classes.positive_core: (catastrophic hypervelocity impact damage:1.3) on satellite structure, torn aluminum honeycomb sandwich panel, exposed hexagonal core cells, ripped and buckled facesheet, twisted structural fragments, large ragged breach, severed harness wires floating stiffly in microgravity

severity.moderate: partial facesheet tear, exposed honeycomb patch, bent edge
severity.severe: large breach through the sandwich panel, splayed core, hanging fragments
severity.catastrophic: massive structural rupture, detached panel section, torn structure and loose stiff cables

damage_classes.negative_extra: tiny pit, minor scratch, pristine intact panel, small pinhole, single small crater, one clean round hole only, spider-web glass cracks, fire glow, smoke plume, explosion flash

damage_classes.label: nominal
damage_classes.positive_core: pristine undamaged satellite exterior surface, clean uniform thermal coating, intact fasteners and seams, factory-fresh spacecraft hardware in orbit, flawless panel
damage_classes.negative_extra: (crater:1.4), (hole:1.4), (crack:1.4), (tear:1.3), (dent:1.3), scratch, pit, puncture, damage, debris, deformation, stain, discoloration

surfaces.surf_al_panel: white-painted aluminum honeycomb satellite bus panel, visible rivets and fasteners, matte thermal control coating
surfaces.surf_mli: gold kapton multi-layer insulation blanket, wrinkled reflective foil, stitched seams and grounding tabs
surfaces.surf_solar: satellite solar array wing, grid of dark blue photovoltaic cells with thin silver gridlines under cover glass, white backing substrate
surfaces.surf_radiator: white optical solar reflector radiator panel, mirror-like quartz tiles arranged in a grid
surfaces.surf_antenna: parabolic high-gain antenna dish, smooth pale composite reflector surface
surfaces.surf_cfrp: bare carbon fiber composite panel, woven twill texture, satin black finish
surfaces.surf_whipple: thin aluminum Whipple shield bumper plate with standoff gap to the main wall visible at the edge
surfaces.surf_sensor: star tracker housing with black anodized baffle and round glass aperture
surfaces.surf_harness: kapton-wrapped cable harness bundle with connectors routed along the satellite edge

lighting.light_direct: harsh direct unfiltered sunlight, extreme contrast, pitch-black hard-edged shadows, no atmospheric scattering, blown specular highlights on bare metal
lighting.light_grazing: grazing low-angle sunlight raking across the surface, terminator lighting, long shadows inside craters and pits emphasizing depth relief
lighting.light_led: eclipse darkness illuminated by a cool white LED inspection lamp, small specular hotspot, vignetted pool of light, surrounding pitch blackness
lighting.light_albedo: soft bluish fill light reflected from Earth below, gentle earthshine illumination lifting the shadows
lighting.light_glint: strong specular sun glint reflecting off metallic foil, high dynamic range, bright star-shaped reflection near the damage

camera.cam_macro: extreme macro close-up at millimeter scale, fine metal grain visible, flat perspective, deep depth of field
camera.cam_inspect: inspection camera view from half a meter, damage centered in frame, slight wide-angle perspective
camera.cam_survey: survey view from three meters showing a full panel section, damage visible among hardware features, slight barrel distortion from a wide lens
camera.cam_oblique: oblique 45-degree viewing angle across the surface, foreshortened perspective on the damage

backgrounds.bg_space: pure black deep space background, no visible stars, short exposure
backgrounds.bg_earth: blue Earth limb with white cloud swirls curving far in the background, slightly out of focus
backgrounds.bg_stars: faint scattered star field in the black background, long exposure
backgrounds.bg_structure: other satellite structures blurred in the background, truss segments and foil-wrapped shapes

dataset_plan.diversity_rule: cross lighting x camera x background x severity within each class; no single combination above 15% of a class; unique seed per image
dataset_plan.real_data_note: Mix real imagery (NASA LDEF crater archive, returned Hubble array photos, Sentinel-1A damage image, ISS inspection photos) into val/test to measure the sim-to-real gap
